remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 1,854 SF townhome offering space, style & convenience. Features include 9' ceilings, crown molding & hardwood floors throughout. The main level boasts an open living/family room with gas fireplace, coat closet, half bath, and sliders to an oversized deck & landscaped flat backyard-perfect for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen offers maple cabinetry, granite counters, stylish backsplash & brand-new SS appliances with gas range. Upstairs are 2 spacious bedrooms, each with en-suite bath. Primary suite includes dual closets; second bedroom has a walk-in & wardrobe closet. Laundry with new LG washer/dryer tower. Pull-down attic adds 600 SF storage. Finished 612 SF basement ideal as 3rd bedroom, office, gym or more. Low $275 HOA includes exterior insurance, landscaping & snow removal. Proven rental history at $3,800/mo. Minutes to SoNo, I-95, Rt 7, train, shopping, dining & Norwalk Hospital. A rare find in a 6-unit self-managed complex!
